message: Here's the good news: the emulation found no failing checks, and every flow we drew is connected. It's blocked because none of the eight IBM components has a native implementation yet. The supported typed contracts only cover this RAG pattern on AWS, plus IBM private object storage on its own, and switching to storage-only would cut the scope you asked for. So a graph edit can't fix this. The fix is product engineering: native IBM implementations for App ID with PKCE, the Code Engine web app, the Code Engine RAG API, Cloudant with ACLs, the ingestion job and the watsonx.ai runtime, plus an import plan for the existing browser reference. Artifact f6ebbc12… is the reproducer, and nothing has been deployed or validated. For this test, should the IBM services stay as they are and wait for those implementations, or would you accept running the AWS-supported RAG pattern alongside as a reference while IBM remains the target?
